scope.cell_family: Current cubic 64-atom parent-MD cells; volume relative to a=4.7 Angstrom starting structure

NBANDS_policy: Keep automatic selection and record actual value; require unoccupied highest band for each label; calibration used 336 at NELECT=512, 56 MPI ranks.

label_schema.energy: e_fr_energy / VASP TOTEN, eV per cell, force-consistent
label_schema.stress: ASE tensile-positive eV/Angstrom^3; Voigt xx yy zz yz xz xy; use ASE conversion once
label_schema.static_pressure: -trace(stress)/3; compression positive; excludes MD kinetic contribution
label_schema.raw_energy_shifts: none; reference alignment is an evaluation operation, not label editing

calibration.scope_note: User fixed ENCUT=600 eV; this campaign certifies the stated k6-versus-k7 comparison, not an absolute DFT accuracy bound.

data_roles.calibration18: protocol calibration and exploratory model diagnosis; not independent test data
data_roles.DFT_pair_duplicates: keep k7 as audit reference; do not double-count k6/k7 as different structures
data_roles.independent_validation_and_test: final labels and reliability thresholds still pending
